authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full traṭ explicitly gives Hindi taṛkā dawn and Old Marwari taṛako morning after crack/crackle verbs, comparing English crack of dawn. These support taḍke/tāḍke/taḍːka/taḍka/tʌɾʌke/ṭaṛaqā morning with source retroflex stops/flaps, gemination and vowels preserved. The addendum says most forms may instead be from √taṭ; keep that published uncertainty and regional transmission qualified. Exact response: ṭaṛaqā.
